title: Schedule of Cash Pickup Transfer Fees and Funding Charges
content:
**Pricing schedule: Cash Pickup.** The transfer fee is set by principal band, and both ends of each band are included. Funding charges and the US-dollar payout fee are shown per tier. All amounts are in US dollars.

## Transfer fee bands

| Cash Pickup tier | Principal band (USD, both ends included) | Transfer fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 10.00 to 999.99 | 2.99 |
| Cash Pickup Economy | 1000.00 to 2999.00 | 3.99 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 10.00 to 499.99 | 3.99 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 500.00 to 999.99 | 4.99 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 1000.00 to 2999.00 | 5.99 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 50.00 to 999.99 | 3.49 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 1000.00 to 2999.99 | 4.49 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 3000.00 to 5000.00 | 5.49 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 10.00 to 999.99 | 3.49 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 1000.00 to 4999.99 | 4.99 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 5000.00 to 7500.00 | 6.99 |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 10.00 to 500.00 | 2.49 |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 3000.00 to 9999.99 | 12.99 |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 10000.00 to 15000.00 | 19.99 |

## Funding charges and US-dollar payout fee

| Cash Pickup tier | Credit-card funding fee (percent of principal) | Debit-card funding fee (USD, flat) | Pay-by-bank discount off the band fee (USD) | US-dollar payout fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 2.00 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 3.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 | 2.00 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 3.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 | 0.00 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1.00 | 0.00 |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.50 | 0.00 |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. A credit-card funding fee of 0.00 percent on a tier means credit cards are not accepted there.
2. The pay-by-bank discount is taken off the band fee and never brings it below 0.00.
3. The US-dollar payout fee applies to a payout in US dollars in a corridor whose local currency is not the US dollar.

## Band boundaries (hypothetical principals)

- Cash Pickup Express, principal 499.99: band 10.00 to 499.99, fee 3.99. Principal 500.00: band 500.00 to 999.99, fee 4.99.
- Cash Pickup Bank Branch, principal 4999.99: fee 4.99. Principal 5000.00: fee 6.99.
- Cash Pickup Express Plus, principal 2999.99: fee 4.49. Principal 3000.00: fee 5.49.
